SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.user_type, u.student_no, u.staff_no, (SELECT MIN(uc.class_id) FROM sys_user_class uc WHERE uc.user_id = u.id AND uc.relation_type = 1) AS class_id, u.major, u.status, u.create_time, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.class_name ORDER BY c.class_name SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_user_class uc JOIN sys_class c ON c.id = uc.class_id WHERE uc.user_id = u.id) AS class_name FROM sys_user u
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND (u.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userId}, '%') OR u.staff_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userId}, '%'))
AND u.user_type = #{userType}
AND u.status = #{status}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_class uc WHERE uc.user_id = u.id AND uc.class_id = #{classId})
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
